meta.login: Sign in to my FOVE account

login.title: My FOVE account
login.subtitle: Find all your FOVE loyalty cards, on any phone.
login.noPassword: No password: we send you a 6-digit code.
login.codeSent: If {email} is correct, a 6-digit code has just been sent to it. It is valid for 10 minutes.
login.checkSpam: Nothing received? Check your spam folder.
login.deleted: Your FOVE account has been deleted.

home.title: My cards
home.welcomeBody: Enter your name so businesses recognise you. Your phone number will be suggested when you join a programme.
home.cardsEmpty: Cards created with your FOVE account will appear here, each in its business's colours.
home.phoneHint: Pre-filled when you join a programme. It is never used to sign in.
home.emailHint: This is the address you sign in with. It can't be changed yet.
home.dangerBody: Your cards stay with each business, with your points, and their links keep working. They are simply no longer grouped in your account.
home.deleteConsequence: Your account is permanently deleted and you are signed out. Your cards and points stay with each business. To erase your data at a business, contact that business.
